promotionBasis: TAG6 formalizes early-signal integrity plus multi-session pre-move behavioral learning. Promotion reflects a structural model upgrade; predictive success still requires prospective multi-session validation and must never be claimed retroactively.

primaryObjective.metric: Early Actionable Capture with Remaining Upside
primaryObjective.formula: Reconciled movers with immutable pre-expansion actionable TAG signal / reconciled mover set
constraints: Do not relabel late detections as early
Do not optimize by alert inflation
Do not claim prediction from hindsight-only pattern discovery

actionableSignalContract.rule: A historical observation cannot be counted as a prediction unless a contemporaneous firstActionableSignalTimestampET exists.

preMoveBehavioralLearning.purpose: Detect silent regime changes before visible price ignition by comparing each stock against its own rolling behavioral baseline.
preMoveBehavioralLearning.behavioralDeviationRule: Store the earliest timestamp where a multi-factor deviation from the stock-specific rolling baseline becomes statistically/materially unusual; do not backfill this timestamp after the outcome is known.

postMoverReverseStudy.trigger: After Final Snapshot Reconciliation, review the largest confirmed movers and reconstruct the prior 20 sessions plus extended hours.
postMoverReverseStudy.hindsightGuard: A pattern discovered after the move is labeled HYPOTHESIS_ONLY and cannot be counted as a prediction for that case.

matchedControlLearning.purpose: Reduce survivorship and hindsight bias by pairing successful movers with non-movers that displayed similar precursor conditions.
matchedControlLearning.minimumPrinciple: Every promoted pattern family must be tested against failure/control cases, not winners alone.

patternFamilyLibrary.promotionRule: A family gains predictive weight only after prospective/out-of-sample success across multiple reconciled sessions with acceptable false-positive behavior.

catalystRegimeClassification.rule: Do not attribute a sudden exogenous news shock to prior technical behavior unless evidence shows the stock was already behaviorally preconditioned before the event.

earlyConversionEngine.promotionRule: Observation becomes actionable only when multi-factor evidence crosses a multi-session calibrated threshold while stage is DISCOVERY or IGNITION and integrity/Sharia gates pass.

reversalIgnitionResearchPath.trainingRule: Do not calibrate or promote this path until multiple reconciled sessions contain comparable cases with timestamped actionable signals and measured false-positive rate.

visibilitySaturationGate.rule: If the candidate is already a conspicuous public mover after substantial expansion, classify DETECTED_LATE unless TAG has an immutable earlier actionable signal.

incrementalUpsideGate.rule: Reward remaining post-signal opportunity and penalize signals issued after most of the move has already occurred.
incrementalUpsideGate.thresholdPolicy: No numeric threshold changes from a single session; calibrate on multiple reconciled sessions.
